newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato says economic growth higher in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato says economic growth higher in Q1.

text.p: Spain's economy grew at a faster rate in the first quarter than in 1996, Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Thursday.
The economy grew at a rate of 2.6 percent in 1996.
"Indicators show the economic cycle is growing at a pace faster than that in 1996," Rato told reporters.
He added that the economy's performance so far suggested that gross domestic product would rise three percent in 1997.
